title: I am going to do it
body:
Okay... in a previous entry I already talked about getting my spark back. Slowly. But surely. I watched 2 youtube videos today that really made me...idk... feel something. Confident? Hopeful? Once again energetic? I can't find the exact word right now.. but yeah.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0UC7c0bxlA 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y4g4ZriKV7A
And after I watched these.. I realized that yeah! I am also pretty fucking goated. Like I know I am not there yet, but if I can't even have the confidence to say that I am CAPABLE of reaching that level, then how can I ever reach it? In the first video it talked about how we were taught to be humble... but the meaning we took from it ended up becoming a con. Like yeah, we should be humble, but not so much that we downplay ourselves. When deep down we all know what exactly we are capable of. I am not really sure why but it feels like the cogs in my brain are finally starting to move once again. When I made progress in my Malware Analysis learning, my brain finally felt alive once again, out of the auto-pilot I unknowingly put it in. To anyone who is reading this, and is currently in their burntout and life fucking you up all the time phase of your life.. I do suggest you watch those 2 pretty short videos. And as it said in the 2nd video... don't just watch and think. Do it. You just need a rough sketch, no need to try and create the "perfect" plan. Just fucking do it.

title: About AI development
body: I used to be a firm opposer of generative AI. I still am, something that is borderline theft should not be tolerated. But I do believe that Agentic AI as a tool is incredible. Need an example? Look at this website! I don't really like writing front-end code, so normally i would have to request a colleague for help, make sure their schedule is available, explain my thought process clearly, or do all these things AND pay a freelance developer... but now? It took me like one day to build this INCREDIBLE portfolio website, something that I once had to request a friend of mine many times to just DESIGN. Not build, nuh uh, just design. So basically I believe for someone like me who likes system architecture and thinking instead of writing a fking 1000 line of code, agentic AI has solved a lot of the problems. For stuff that we just HAD to do before because there was no other way, ideas that we had to keep in store cuz building it was too time-consuming and troublesome... now it's easily doable! I am not an AI-tech bro. I am against all the unethical stuff that AI companies are doing, but just pushing against the whole development of technology isn't really fair either. And in some ways, if you really think about it, these technologies were also available before, but only to the privileged, but now it's available to the common populace.

title: Finally getting my spark back
body: After a inconveniently long burnout hiatus. I am finally getting my technical and "big-brain-thinking" spark back. Life's still pretty shit, August made me realize that things can always get worse, September is still kicking my ass but at least slowly I am coming to terms with everything, and getting back to the grind. I guess it was right when they said that, you don't always need to be on the hustle, sometimes life does make you fall. What's important is that even if you have to crawl, you still get up.
